headings.text: How to view or amend this notification

paragraphs: Tell the transporter that this consignment must go directly to the place of destination on entry to Great Britain.
The animals or consignment may need to be inspected.
If so, the animals must stay at the place of destination for either:
You can view or amend this notification from your dashboard and resubmit it.
To get help with import notifications for live animals or germinal products, email importsriskmanagement@apha.gov.uk.
Contact the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) if you need technical help with this service:
Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5pm, except bank holidays
If you need help with your customs declaration, contact HMRC.

48 hours if no time is specified
